meta.name: hotspots
meta.description: Find where a codebase actually costs time by mining its git history (Tornhill hotspot analysis). Produces ranked refactoring targets with evidence, change-coupling seams, and a do-not-refactor list; re-run after refactoring to verify it paid off.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出代码库中成本最高的模块，用数据指导重构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道哪些代码最值得花时间重构
copy.tagline_en: Identify costliest modules in your codebase with data-driven refactoring targets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want data-driven priorities for where to refactor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过分析 Git 历史，按变更频率和复杂度对文件排名，生成带证据的重构目标、变更耦合列表和“不要重构”清单，并能在重构后验证是否有效。
howto.when: 当你要求分析代码库的热点或检查某次重构的效果时触发。

say.text: 分析当前代码库的热点，给出重构优先级
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的热点分析流程并生成报告。

say.text: 验证上次重构后，热点指标是否改善
say.note: Claude 会重新运行脚本并与基线数据对比。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude mines Git history, ranks files by change frequency and complexity, and produces a report of refactoring targets with evidence, change-coupling seams, and a do-not-refactor list. It can also verify past refactoring by comparing before/after metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze codebase hotspots or verify the effect of a previous refactoring.

say_en.text: Analyze this repo's hotspots and rank refactoring targets.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full hotspot analysis and writes a report.

say_en.text: Verify if the last refactoring reduced complexity.
say_en.note: Claude re-runs scripts and compares to the baseline.
